records.meta: Chinese suspense short drama · Mandarin · 60 episodes · mainland China premiere 12 Apr 2026 on the Guozi / 果子 platform · leads Lan Lan (张晴) and Li Zhuoyang (赵江海 / 赵江河)
records.character: Zhang Qing (张晴), adult wife of Zhao Jianghai
records.mechanism: The official encyclopedia plot says she is controlled by both drugs and hypnosis while living under her husband's care in a small town.
records.summary: After the deaths of her parents and a miscarriage, Zhang Qing is taken by her husband Zhao Jianghai to live in seclusion. Official plot sources say the care is a planned confinement: she is kept under drug and hypnotic control until a switched prescription and a doctor's help let her recover her awareness and look into the deaths and the miscarriage. Li Zhuoyang plays the husband's two faces, Zhao Jianghai and Zhao Jianghe. This record enriches the existing April 2026 catalog card of the same title, which previously could not confirm that the husband was the hypnotist. It is a different work from the later 被催眠的她 (Lin Xiaowan / Jiang Lin) card.
records.already_married_note: Yes — Zhang Qing is already married to Zhao Jianghai when the hypnosis and confinement take place.
records.pregnancy_note: Official plot sources state a miscarriage (意外流产 / 丧子之痛) as part of the backstory the couple is living with; they do not describe her as pregnant at the end.
records.kids_note: The cited official plot sources do not mention any children of Zhang Qing from before this marriage.
records.kids_together_note: The couple's pregnancy ended in a miscarriage. The cited sources do not mention a living child of the couple.
